description: Source file implementing the base WLAN hardware abstraction layer for DWPALD in the prplMesh project, including FSM setup, command handling, radio and VAP info refresh, and event processing.

classes.name: base_wlan_hal_dwpal
classes.description: Implementation of WLAN HAL for DWPALD, managing FSM, command interface, radio/VAP info, and events.

methods.name: fsm_setup
methods.description: Configures the FSM states and transitions for the WLAN interface.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Initiates attachment process, blocking or non-blocking.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a parameter on the WLAN interface.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping command to the interface.

methods.name: dwpal_send_cmd
methods.description: Sends a command to DWPALD and processes reply.

methods.name: attach_dwpald_interface
methods.description: Attaches to a specific vap interface.

methods.name: refresh_radio_info
methods.description: Refreshes radio information including status and capabilities.

methods.name: refresh_vap_info
methods.description: Refreshes information for a specific VAP.

methods.name: refresh_vaps_info
methods.description: Refreshes all VAPs info based on configuration.

methods.name: get_radio_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the radio interface.

methods.name: update_conn_status
methods.description: Updates connection status for interface and VAPs.
